title: CRAB: A Benchmark for Evaluating Curation of Retrieval-Augmented LLMs in Biomedicine

model.params_source: assumed (paper gives no decoding parameters for o3-mini)

task.subset_rule: all 400 CRAB queries (100 per language file: en, french, german, chinese); per query a seeded (20260907) draw of references balanced 40% relevant / 60% irrelevant (n_rel = min(#positive, floor(2/3 x #negative)), n_irr = round(1.5 x n_rel)); items = the drawn references (~7 per query)
task.approximation: the paper's per-query 40/60 draw is not listed (seeded draw, set-level comparison); the 'Query:' / 'References:' layout and the expected output format are reconstructed (only the instruction sentence is printed); no item-level CI (F1)

items.source: zhm0/CRAB, config benchmark, files en_data.jsonl / french_data.jsonl / german_data.jsonl / zh_data.jsonl (100 queries each; fields question, positive (list of relevant reference strings prefixed '[n] '), negative (list of irrelevant references))
items.config_or_split: benchmark; splits en, french, german, chinese
items.filter: queries with at least one positive and one negative reference (a few queries have no relevant reference)

prompt.source_location: Appendix C.1.2 Implementation Details (Task A prompt template)
prompt.verbatim: partial: the instruction sentence is verbatim; the 'Query:' / 'References:' layout is reconstructed (not printed)

output.parse: sequence of 0/1 labels in reference order: a bracketed list like [1, 0, 1, ...] or per-line '[n]: label' / 'n: label'; length must equal the number of references
output.postprocess: strip; missing or extra labels -> the query is re-parsed leniently, else all its references count as predicted 0 and the query is reported

metric.name: custom
metric.definition: Relevance Precision (RP) = F1 of the relevant class (label 1) over all drawn references pooled across queries (Sec. 2.3: RP/IS/CE are the F1 of the relevant/irrelevant class and the macro F1)
metric.original_location: Table 7, row o3-mini, column Relevance Precision / SRC (IS 73.99, CE 72.60)

cost.prepare_note: runner --prepare 2026-09-07: est_usd_prepare counts <=400 output tokens per free-text call (runner out_guess); est_usd_dryrun_max_tokens counts the full max_tokens

notes: References are abstracts (~200 words each), so calls carry ~1.5k input tokens. The headline Table 2 numbers use the unprinted main CRAB instruction and stay out of scope. || [hook 2026-09-07] load_items() reads the four language files (400 queries; 11 without a positive or negative reference skipped -> 389 queries), draws per query with one RNG (seed 20260907) a 40/60 relevant/irrelevant reference set (n_rel = min(#pos, floor(2/3 #neg)), n_irr = min(#neg, round(1.5 n_rel))), shuffles and renumbers [1]..[n]: 2,371 references (938 relevant); parse() reads per-reference 0/1 labels ('[k] 1', 'k: 0', 'Reference k - 1') or a bare 0/1 sequence; score() pools all references: RP = F1 of the relevant class (returned), IS = F1 of the irrelevant class, CE = macro F1 (printed); an unparsable reply predicts 0 for its references. C.1.2 fixes the 400-query (four-language) protocol, so Table 7 is compared on all languages.
